caption: The drawing depicts a simplified architectural facade of a building, rendered in grayscale. The building has a gable roof shape with the upper portion consisting of a large triangular section. In the upper center of the facade, there is a rectangular window or niche with a small horizontal projection above it, resembling a lintel. The middle portion of the building features a pattern resembling stacked stones or bricks. The lower part of the building displays three evenly spaced, rounded arches. Below the architectural drawing, there are two ribbon-like banners; the left banner contains the number "1797" and the right banner has the text "mision san juan bautista" written on it in lowercase letters. The background is plain and light-colored, and the drawing appears to be made with fine dots or stippling.
title: Mision San Juan Bautista
